name: app.R
content:
# Statistics (I), Week 9: Continuous Probability Distributions (Part I)
# Interactive demonstrations for class
#   Tab 1: a histogram approaches a density curve as the bars get narrower
#   Tab 2: the shape and location of a normal distribution, given its mean and SD
#
# Run in R:  shiny::runApp("path/to/this/folder")   (needs the shiny package only)

library(shiny)

# Delivery-time example from the lecture notes: mean 25 minutes, SD 4 minutes
MU0 <- 25
SD0 <- 4

ui <- navbarPage(
  title = "Week 9: Continuous Distributions",

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Tab 1
  tabPanel(
    "From Bars to Areas",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        sliderInput("bw", "Bar width (minutes)",
                    min = 0.25, max = 6, value = 4, step = 0.25),
        sliderInput("n", "Number of orders recorded",
                    min = 100, max = 20000, value = 2000, step = 100),
        checkboxInput("show_curve", "Show the density curve", value = FALSE),
        sliderInput("ab", "Highlight orders between a and b (minutes)",
                    min = 10, max = 40, value = c(30, 40), step = 0.5),
        actionButton("resample", "Record a new sample"),
        hr(),
        helpText("Delivery times follow a normal distribution with mean 25",
                 "and SD 4 minutes. The vertical axis is relative frequency",
                 "divided by bar width, so the AREA of each bar is the",
                 "proportion of orders in that bar.")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        plotOutput("hist_plot", height = "430px"),
        tableOutput("area_table")
      )
    )
  ),

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Tab 2
  tabPanel(
    "The Normal Family",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        sliderInput("mu", HTML("Mean μ (location)"),
                    min = -30, max = 30, value = 0, step = 0.5),
        sliderInput("sigma", HTML("Standard deviation σ (scale)"),
                    min = 1, max = 10, value = 1, step = 0.5),
        radioButtons("band", "Shade the area within",
                     choices = c("None" = 0,
                                 "mu +/- 1 SD" = 1,
                                 "mu +/- 2 SD" = 2,
                                 "mu +/- 3 SD" = 3),
                     selected = 0),
        checkboxInput("show_ref", "Show the standard normal N(0, 1) for reference", value = TRUE),
        actionButton("reset", "Reset to the standard normal (mean 0, SD 1)"),
        hr(),
        helpText("Change the mean: the curve slides left or right.",
                 "Change the SD: the curve stretches or squeezes.",
                 "Because the total area is always 1, a wider curve must be lower.")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        plotOutput("normal_plot", height = "430px"),
        tableOutput("normal_table")
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ Tab 1 logic
  sample_data <- reactive({
    input$resample                     # re-run when the button is pressed
    rnorm(input$n, mean = MU0, sd = SD0)
  })

  hist_obj <- reactive({
    x  <- sample_data()
    bw <- input$bw
    # Bar edges anchored at the mean, wide enough to cover every observation
    k_lo <- floor((min(x) - MU0) / bw) - 1
    k_hi <- ceiling((max(x) - MU0) / bw) + 1
    brks <- MU0 + bw * (k_lo:k_hi)
    hist(x, breaks = brks, plot = FALSE)
  })

  output$hist_plot <- renderPlot({
    h  <- hist_obj()
    a  <- input$ab[1]
    b  <- input$ab[2]
    left  <- head(h$breaks, -1)
    right <- tail(h$breaks, -1)
    inside <- h$mids >= a & h$mids <= b

    par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 2, 1))
    plot(NA, xlim = c(5, 45), ylim = c(0, 0.13),
         xlab = "Delivery time (minutes)",
         ylab = "Relative frequency / bar width",
         main = paste0("Bar width = ", input$bw, " minutes,  n = ", input$n))
    rect(left, 0, right, h$density,
         col = ifelse(inside, "#F4A261", "#CFE1F2"), border = "grey40")
    abline(v = c(a, b), lty = 2, col = "#E76F51", lwd = 1.5)

    if (input$show_curve) {
      curve(dnorm(x, MU0, SD0), from = 5, to = 45, n = 400,
            add = TRUE, lwd = 3, col = "#1D3557")
    }
    legend("topright", bty = "n",
           legend = c("Bars inside [a, b]", "Other bars",
                      if (input$show_curve) "Density curve"),
           fill = c("#F4A261", "#CFE1F2", if (input$show_curve) NA),
           border = c("grey40", "grey40", if (input$show_curve) NA),
           lwd = c(NA, NA, if (input$show_curve) 3),
           col = c(NA, NA, if (input$show_curve) "#1D3557"))
  })

  output$area_table <- renderTable({
    x <- sample_data()
    h <- hist_obj()
    a <- input$ab[1]
    b <- input$ab[2]
    data.frame(
      Quantity = c("Total area of all bars",
                   paste0("Proportion of recorded orders between ", a, " and ", b),
                   paste0("Area under the curve between ", a, " and ", b)),
      Value = c(sprintf("%.4f", sum(h$density * diff(h$breaks))),
                sprintf("%.4f", mean(x > a & x < b)),
                sprintf("%.4f", pnorm(b, MU0, SD0) - pnorm(a, MU0, SD0)))
    )
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ Tab 2 logic
  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    updateSliderInput(session, "mu", value = 0)
    updateSliderInput(session, "sigma", value = 1)
  })

  output$normal_plot <- renderPlot({
    mu <- input$mu
    s  <- input$sigma
    k  <- as.numeric(input$band)
    xs <- seq(-90, 90, length.out = 2000)

    par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 2, 1))
    plot(NA, xlim = c(-60, 60), ylim = c(0, 0.42),
         xlab = "x", ylab = "Density",
         main = sprintf("Normal distribution with mean %.1f and SD %.1f", mu, s))

    if (k > 0) {
      xx <- seq(mu - k * s, mu + k * s, length.out = 400)
      polygon(c(xx, rev(xx)), c(dnorm(xx, mu, s), rep(0, length(xx))),
              col = "#F4A26199", border = NA)
      pct <- 100 * (pnorm(k) - pnorm(-k))
      text(mu, dnorm(mu, mu, s) * 0.45,
           sprintf("%.1f%%", pct), cex = 1.4, font = 2)
      abline(v = mu + c(-k, k) * s, lty = 3, col = "#E76F51")
    }
    if (input$show_ref) {
      lines(xs, dnorm(xs, 0, 1), lty = 2, lwd = 2, col = "grey55")
    }
    lines(xs, dnorm(xs, mu, s), lwd = 3, col = "#1D3557")
    segments(mu, 0, mu, dnorm(mu, mu, s), lty = 2, col = "#1D3557")
    mtext(expression(mu), side = 1, at = mu, line = 0.3, col = "#1D3557")

    legend("topright", bty = "n",
           legend = c("Your curve", if (input$show_ref) "Standard normal N(0, 1)"),
           lwd = c(3, if (input$show_ref) 2),
           lty = c(1, if (input$show_ref) 2),
           col = c("#1D3557", if (input$show_ref) "grey55"))
  })

  output$normal_table <- renderTable({
    mu <- input$mu
    s  <- input$sigma
    data.frame(
      Quantity = c("Mean = median = mode",
                   "Peak height = 1 / (sigma * sqrt(2 pi))",
                   "About 68% of values lie between",
                   "About 95% of values lie between",
                   "Practically all (99.7%) lie between",
                   "Total area under the curve"),
      Value = c(sprintf("%.1f", mu),
                sprintf("%.4f", dnorm(mu, mu, s)),
                sprintf("%.1f and %.1f", mu - s, mu + s),
                sprintf("%.1f and %.1f", mu - 2 * s, mu + 2 * s),
                sprintf("%.1f and %.1f", mu - 3 * s, mu + 3 * s),
                "1")
    )
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
